<a id="ia.server-rendered-content"></a>

### 3.1 Server-side rendered content

- Stable ID: `ia.server-rendered-content`
- Stage: Read
- Strength: MUST
- AR practices: AR-READ-01, AR-READ-03 (mapping: full)
- Evidence type: `measured_study`
- Fix: Render the main content on the server so the HTML has text without JavaScript.
- Fix workflow: [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md#ia.server-rendered-content)
- Expected result: more than 200 characters of text
- Rescan: `isagentready results {domain} --checkpoint ia.server-rendered-content`
- Details: https://isagentready.com/en/methodology/checkpoints/ia.server-rendered-content

Verify:

```bash
curl -sf https://{domain}/ | sed -e 's/<[^>]*>//g' | tr -s ' \n' | wc -c
```
